phrase: the bullet time thingy where the camera swishes around them mid-air

spec.movement: a fast, smooth arc of about 130 degrees around the subject: it starts behind the shoulder, passes the profile and stops at a front three-quarter view; it never reaches a view straight in front
spec.placement: at the subject's own height, the lens level, 2 to 3 m away, on one side of the action for the whole move
spec.lens_why: Wide enough to feel the camera travel past the background, not so wide that bodies bend at the frame edge.
spec.light: One hard low sun, camera facing into the light
risks: A full 180 or 360 degree orbit turns faces into the lens and flips left and right on screen. Ask for about 130 degrees.
Generators let frozen bodies float upward. Write 'real gravity, drifting only a hand's width'.
The background behind the subject is invented during the move. Keep the place simple.

one_line: Two masked ninjas at the top of a jump off a low wall; time almost stops while the camera sweeps a fast, smooth arc of about 130 degrees around them at their own height, lens level, from behind the shoulder past the profile to a front three-quarter view; 35 mm lens; one hard low sun as the only strong light, behind the subject; the camera faces into the light; bright rims on hair and shoulders, long shadows that fall toward the lens, about a third of the frame in deep true shadow; bleach-bypass look: high contrast, low saturation, silvery highlights, dense blacks, visible grain; time almost stops: the subject drifts only a hand's width while the camera moves fast; real gravity returns at the end of the move. Avoid: the camera never completes a half circle and never reaches a view straight in front of the face; real gravity and real jump height, nobody floats; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no slow floating camera drift; the camera is locked or makes one decisive move with a clear end; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays.
prompt_block:
SHOT: Frozen-moment arc (bullet time). 16:9 frame, 2 to 3 s.
SUBJECT AND ACTION: two masked ninjas at the top of a jump off a low wall, in a walled courtyard at sunset.
CAMERA MOVE: a fast, smooth arc of about 130 degrees around the subject: it starts behind the shoulder, passes the profile and stops at a front three-quarter view; it never reaches a view straight in front.
CAMERA PLACEMENT: at the subject's own height, the lens level, 2 to 3 m away, on one side of the action for the whole move.
LENS: 35 mm.
LIGHT: one hard low sun as the only strong light, behind the subject; the camera faces into the light; bright rims on hair and shoulders, long shadows that fall toward the lens, about a third of the frame in deep true shadow.
COLOUR: bleach-bypass look: high contrast, low saturation, silvery highlights, dense blacks, visible grain.
SPEED: time almost stops: the subject drifts only a hand's width while the camera moves fast; real gravity returns at the end of the move.
RULES: State the exact number of people. Screen direction stays the same for the whole shot.
AVOID: the camera never completes a half circle and never reaches a view straight in front of the face; real gravity and real jump height, nobody floats; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no slow floating camera drift; the camera is locked or makes one decisive move with a clear end; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays; no soft even glow; one motivated light source with a real dark side; worn real textures with dust, creases and small defects, nothing plastic or perfectly clean.
image_prompt:
A single still frame from a live-action film, 16:9 frame. A storyboard-grade production mock that shows framing, lens, light and colour.
SUBJECT: two masked ninjas at the top of a jump off a low wall, in a walled courtyard at sunset. Generic stand-in figures, not a likeness of any real person.
CAMERA: the camera is at the middle of its arc, exactly side-on: the subject in clean profile at their own height. Camera placement: at the subject's own height, the lens level, 2 to 3 m away, on one side of the action for the whole move.
LENS: 35 mm; moderately wide lens look: subject and surroundings both readable, natural perspective.
LIGHT: one hard low sun as the only strong light, behind the subject; the camera faces into the light; bright rims on hair and shoulders, long shadows that fall toward the lens, about a third of the frame in deep true shadow.
COLOUR: bleach-bypass look: high contrast, low saturation, silvery highlights, dense blacks, visible grain.
MOMENT: everything caught perfectly sharp at one instant: dust and small debris hang still in the air.
FACES: turned away from the lens, in profile, three-quarter or from behind.
AVOID: the camera never completes a half circle and never reaches a view straight in front of the face; real gravity and real jump height, nobody floats; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no soft even glow; one motivated light source with a real dark side; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays; matte worn floor, no glossy or wet reflections; worn real textures with dust, creases and small defects, nothing plastic or perfectly clean; no over-saturated HDR look; restrained colour and true blacks; no lens flare unless the light source itself is in the frame.
One frame only: no collage, no split screen, no text, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no border.
